# CCProxy API

> > A reverse proxy server for Claude API with an extensible plugin architecture supporting authentication, middleware, and custom providers.

CCProxy enables developers to build plugin-based extensions for Claude API interactions, featuring OAuth authentication, declarative configuration via TOML, and a comprehensive plugin system with auth providers, base providers, and middleware components. The documentation covers architecture, authoring guides, and configuration setup.

## Key Topics

- CCProxy
- Claude API
- Plugin Architecture
- OAuth Authentication
- PluginManifest
- PluginFactory
- PluginRegistry
- AuthProviderPluginFactory
- BaseProviderPluginFactory
- Middleware
- RouteSpec
- TOML Configuration
- Plugin Lifecycle
- Claude SDK
- Proxy Server

- [Configuration](https://caddyglow.github.io/ccproxy-api/getting-started/configuration/): Setup guide for CCProxy API server using TOML config and env variables

- [Overview](https://caddyglow.github.io/ccproxy-api/PLUGIN_SYSTEM_DOCUMENTATION/): Plugin system architecture overview for CCProxy reverse proxy to Claude API
- [Authoring Guide](https://caddyglow.github.io/ccproxy-api/PLUGIN_AUTHORING/): Developer guide for creating CCProxy plugins with auth and provider factories
